text.zh_HK: 1996年，同一條街。倒數牌減到三位數，隔籬舖嘅閘門拉落咗。
text.zh_CN: 1996年，同一条街。倒数牌减到三位数，隔壁铺的闸门拉下来了。
text.en: 1996, the same street. The countdown is down to three digits and the next door's shutter is down for good.

text.zh_HK: 樓上有盞燈亮住——有人寫緊一封寄唔出嘅信。
text.zh_CN: 楼上有盏灯亮着——有人在写一封寄不出的信。
text.en: Upstairs a lamp is on. Someone is writing a letter that will not be sent.

text.zh_HK: 聽阿彩講呢封信嘅故事。
text.zh_CN: 听阿彩讲这封信的故事。
text.en: Hear the story of the letter.

text.zh_HK: 搵由溫哥華返嚟嘅阿雪。
text.zh_CN: 找从温哥华回来的阿雪。

text.zh_HK: 信封終於有郵票。阿雪話，阿媽見到妹妹嘅字，一定喊住笑。
text.zh_CN: 信封终于有邮票。阿雪说，妈妈见到妹妹的字，一定会哭着笑。
text.en: The envelope finally has its stamp. Suet says her mother will cry and laugh at once when she sees her sister's hand.

text.zh_HK: 你返到2027年。抽屜入面嗰封信，終於寄咗——二十幾年後，先寄到。
text.zh_CN: 你回到2027年。抽屉里的那封信，终于寄了——二十多年后，才寄到。
text.en: You are back in 2027. The letter in the drawer has finally been sent — twenty-some years late, and on its way.

_comment: Chapter-5 arc (PLAN §12.1): the unsent letter is the door; the resolution is delivery, not repair — 阿雪 carries the letter to the address her mother left. The player's 2027 copy of the letter is what 阿彩 recognizes; no time travel is ever explained. Offline fallback lines carry every flag beat.
